what.text: This page follows refugees from Yemen living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5663 Yemeni refugees in the United Kingdom, 9.9% of all refugees from Yemen.
Somalia hosts the most Yemeni refugees, followed by the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with Ansarallah and AQAP among the opponents.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between the United Kingdom and Yemen in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
